summary: @or-sdk/library-types-v2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a types-only Zod/TypeScript library but ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts the binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js`, a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with hex-obfuscated identifiers and string-array rotation routines. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is listed in the `files` whitelist in `package.json` (which declares only `./dist/browser`, `./dist/nest`, `CHANGELOG.md`), yet both are shipped in the tarball and are the install-time execution artifacts. A types-only package has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute a large opaque bundle under it; this matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to run obfuscated code outside Node-focused static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
